notes.title: Introducing: Bows & Mixtures VR Bundle
notes.content:
Hello Wanderers!

We're proudly announcing that Mixture is teaming up with Elven Assassin!

[h3]Buy Mixture & Elven Assassin to save 10%![/h3]

Grab an elven bow and shoot thousands of arrows in the heads of orcs, trolls and dragons solo or in a co-op in the dark fantasy 'Elven Assassin'. Brew potions, sharpen scythe, and mix & slash your way controlling simultaneously an alchemist and a knight in any less darker fantasy 'Mixture'.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39135/Bows__Mixtures_VR_Bundle/

If you decide to buy both games, you'll receive 10% off for each of them.
If you already own any of those two, you'll get a bonus discount for missing one.

Brace yourself! Buy a bundle now and immerse yourself in fantasy worlds for dozens of hours!
And give lots of love to Wenkly Studio, our brothers in arms!

See you on the Battlegrounds!

notes.title: Introducing: Wizards & Alchemists VR Bundle
notes.content:
Hello Wanderers!

We're proudly announcing that Mixture is teaming up with The Wizards!

[h3]Buy Mixture & The Wizards - Enhanced Edition to save 10%![/h3]

Become a powerful Wizard in The Wizards and control the Master of Alchemy in Mixture! Cast powerful spells with immersive hand gestures to vanquish your foes or mix and slash your way through the opposition with alchemical and knightly skills! Explore beautiful fantasy worlds, challenge demons and dragons, customize spells and mixtures, and embark on two incredible fantasy journeys!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39134/Wizards__Alchemists_VR_Bundle/

If you decide to buy both games, you'll receive 10% off for each of them.
If you already own any of those two, you'll get a bonus discount for missing one.

Brace yourself! Buy a bundle now and immerse yourself in fantasy worlds for dozens of hours!
And give lots of love to Carbon Studio, our brothers in arms!

See you in the Fantasylands!

notes.title: Mixture is now available on PCVR & PSVR2!
notes.content:
The waiting is over, Alchemists!

Our second game, Mixture, is now available on Steam & PSVR2!

[h3]Buy Mixture on Steam now![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133890/Mixture/

[h3]Watch Mixture Launch Trailer![/h3]
[previewyoutube=Wva1HFjqu68;full][/previewyoutube]
Play as 2 characters at the same time - Alchemist & Knight. Traverse dangerous barren worlds of living metals, ores and crystals to find means of redemption.

[h3][url=https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10009742]Buy PSVR2 digital edition in PlayStation Store![/url][/h3]
[h3][url=https://perpgames.com/product/mixture/]Buy PSVR2 physical edition in Perp Games Shop now![/url]
